plugins.name: obsidian
plugins.description: Drive an Obsidian vault from the terminal — daily notes, search, file ops, tags, tasks, plugin reloading, and headless scripting via the official obsidian CLI.

plugins.name: readout
plugins.description: Report operational results as terse machine readouts — delta bridges, scan tables, verdict blocks, alarm stacks, and event sequences — instead of narrative prose.

plugins.name: domain-gloss
plugins.description: Keep English domain terms and schema identifiers exact, with first-language explanations beside jargon, false friends, and opaque table or field names in conversation.

plugins.name: thai-natural-voice
plugins.description: Draft natural Thai and capture reusable voice profiles from links, names, documents, or Slack authors through an authorized connector or local CLI.

plugins.name: blank-brain-recap
plugins.description: Rebuild yesterday's working context in any repo or multi-repo workspace — last active day from git, planning STATE and HANDOFF notes, open pull requests, dated ledger rows — as one terse readout ending in a single next step.

plugins.name: safe-to-exit
plugins.description: Verify a working session can be ended safely — uncommitted and unpushed work, secrets about to be committed, unfinished-work markers, still-running servers, subagents and loop modes, and pull requests waiting on you — as one SAFE / SAFE WITH NOTES / NOT SAFE verdict.
